leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply Angular service creation to generate a dedicated service for push notification functionality.
Use the Notification API to request user permission for displaying push notifications.
Implement service worker registration to enable background push notification handling.
Execute conditional logic to check browser support for push notifications before proceeding.
Construct notification payloads with title, body, and icon properties for user display.
Utilize the ServiceWorkerRegistration interface to access the push manager subscription.
Define subscription handling to store and retrieve push subscription data on the server.
Invoke notification display methods to show push notifications to users when received.
Handle push events in the service worker to process incoming push notifications.
Apply click event listeners to notifications to navigate users to specific application views.
Modify notification options to customize visual appearance and behavior based on application needs.
Control notification permission states to manage user preferences and application flow.
